Event Processing Delays of Up to 30 Minutes. [resolved]
item.description:
We observed elevated error rates in the Event Consumption service between 05:02 PM and 05:25 PM IST, which resulted in delays in event processing.
Our Engineering team identified the issue, mitigated the impact, and restored normal service. Event processing has resumed, and any backlog generated during the incident has been cleared.
Current Status: Resolved. All services are operating normally, and event processing is functioning as expected.

Service Disruption Due to AWS Outage [resolved]
item.description:
Start Time: October 20, 2025 at 07:10 UTC End Time: October 20, 2025 at 10:53 PM UTC
Summary: Some customers may have experienced slow sync performance and intermittent errors during the global AWS outage on October 20, 2025.
Cause: The issue was caused by an incident in the AWS us-east-1 region, impacting several dependent services and resulting in temporary sync delays and connection timeouts.
Resolution: After AWS restored stability across their services, Hevo systems automatically recovered, and all sync operations have returned to normal.
Next Steps: We continue to monitor platform performance closely and are taking measures to further strengthen resilience against third-party service disruptions.
